description: South Korean stocks opened higher Thursday as a better-than-expected US unemployment report for January boosted prospects that the Federal Reserve may keep interest rates unchanged. The benchmark Korea Composite Stock Price Index added 62.74 points, or 1.17 percent, to 5,417.23 in the first 15 minutes of trading.
